capabilities: Convert a whole note, a selection, or a folder to speech
Save generated audio in the vault and link it to the source note
Play audio in a floating player with pause, seeking and speed control
Connect to cloud or local TTS providers with custom endpoints
disambiguation: Not a podcast publishing or RSS tool; it generates speech audio from notes and plays it inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only; macOS tested, Windows and Linux untested in this release. Credentials are stored unencrypted in data.json and may be included in vault sync. No voice models or reference recordings are bundled. Community directory approval is pending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn written notes into audio, so notes can only be read on screen.

requires.name: Node.js, FFmpeg, sherpa-onnx-node and a SenseVoice model

summary: Converts notes, selections, or folders to speech using cloud or local TTS providers, saves the audio in the vault, and plays it back with sentence highlighting.
